target_customer: Developers and companies needing passwordless login and device fraud detection
problem: Passwords are weak and costly; sites need a login that resists account takeover and bots.
business_model: Developer SaaS with free and paid plans

founders.name: Zain Azeem
founders.background_notes: Later led anti-fraud analytics at Signifyd per YC profile.

founders.name: Saif Malik
founders.background_notes: About 14 years in technology and finance, per YC profile.

technical_complexity.rationale: QR based cryptographic login across web and mobile SDKs requires solid security engineering, but builds on WebAuthn standards.

defensibility.rationale: Authentication SDKs were crowded and standards based, with weak lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large identity vendors offered passwordless; Keyri partnered with Ping Identity in 2022-09 and its team later joined Signifyd.

market_need_then: Account takeover and password fatigue were widely discussed; no company specific demand data found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found beyond product pages.

pivots.why: YC profile now leads with fraud prevention; timing and reason not found.

outcome_analysis: Keyri sold QR code passwordless login and later added device fingerprinting for fraud prevention, partnering with Ping Identity in 2022. Its team joined Signifyd to strengthen account takeover protection, with no date or price disclosed.
